queries: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage

assumptions.assumption: Observatory stations are counted only if at least one telescope matches them, because the inner join drops everything else. The fraction's denominator is the total of those stations across all phases. A station whose telescopes all have a NULL bandusagepct is still counted, but its NULL average is ignored in the phase average.
A NULL lunarstage forms its own group. Fractions are computed as decimals, with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: The station count and fraction cover every observatory in the observatories table, including stations with no telescopes. The bandwidth average still uses only stations that have telescopes.

assumptions.assumption: Stations are counted only if they have at least one telescope, because the inner join drops the rest. The fraction's denominator is the total of those stations across all phases. A station whose telescopes all have a missing bandusagepct is still counted, but it adds nothing to the average.
A NULL lunarstage forms its own group. Each observstation is unique in observatories, so it belongs to exactly one phase.

alternatives.interpretation: Count every observatory station, including ones with no telescopes, in the station count and in the fraction's denominator. Their station averages are missing and so are ignored in the average.
